name: M'ONDUNIQ BOTOPAX peptide cocktail with white truffle
shortDescription: Botox-inspired peptide concentrate with Argireline, Matrixyl Synthe'6 and Perfection Peptide P3 peptides, white truffle extract and colloidal gold. 10 × 3 ml sterile ampoules.
description:
M'ONDUNIQ BOTOPAX Peptide Cocktail with White Truffle Extract is one of the most exceptional active-ingredient concentrates for professional anti-ageing treatments, combining modern peptide technology with a luxurious blend of white truffle extract, colloidal gold and intensive hydrating complexes.

The name BOTOPAX is no coincidence. The product contains advanced peptides – including Argireline and Matrixyl Synthe'6 – that are counted among the "botox-like peptides" in the cosmetics industry. These modern cosmetic ingredients can help reduce the visibility of expression lines and result in a smoother complexion, while supporting collagen production and the skin's natural regeneration. As a result, the skin can look more rested, firmer and more youthful – all as part of injection-free, professional cosmetic treatments.

BOTOPAX does not contain botulinum toxin and does not replace medical botox treatment. It got its name because it uses advanced peptides known in the cosmetics industry for their botox-inspired mechanism of action. The goal is not to block muscles but to improve the condition of the skin and reduce the cosmetic appearance of wrinkles.

White truffle extract enriches the formula with valuable antioxidants, vitamins and minerals, while colloidal gold enhances the skin's natural radiance and lends treatments an exclusive touch. The Aquaxyl and Lactil complexes provide deep hydration, support skin barrier function and improve skin comfort in the long term.

BOTOPAX is especially recommended for clients who want to achieve visibly smoother, plumper and more radiant skin with premium anti-ageing treatments.

faq.question: Which treatments can the BOTOPAX peptide cocktail be used for?
faq.answer: Areas of use: microneedle mesotherapy, nano treatments, electroporation, oxygen infusion treatments, cold plasma treatments, ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery, radiofrequency treatments, face, neck and décolleté rejuvenation programmes, professional anti-ageing protocols.

faq.question: How should it be used?
faq.answer: Apply the required amount of serum to cleansed skin, then gently work it in until fully absorbed.

faq.question: Can it be combined with other actives?
faq.answer: In professional treatments it can be used on its own or combined with other anti-ageing actives.

faq.question: How do we finish the treatment?
faq.answer: Finish the treatment with a moisturising cream; in the daytime routine, a high-SPF sunscreen is recommended.
